verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official Databricks SDK for Python for automating operations and accelerating development. Its API reference says pages include examples using "one or more of the Databricks SDKs." Databricks Connect is also an official client library that can be embedded in any application, like a JDBC driver. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SDKs beyond Python (other languages only implied by the plural 'SDKs'), SDK depth such as coverage, auth and versioning details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
